name: pstack-herdr
description: Lets pstack use agents from other companies through Herdr. When a pstack seat names a non-Claude model, such as a GPT model, it is started as its own agent in a Herdr tab instead of quietly running on Claude. Run /pstack-herdr first: it checks which agents and models this machine has, then runs pstack's own setup. Needs the pstack plugin and Herdr.
